notes.title: Unity News and other Projects
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

Wanted to give a quick update given recent news about Unity charging per game install...
I'll end up taking this game off of steam in the coming months, it's been great seeing how many people have played this (recently got to 37K!!) 

However I've been working on some bigger and better things! For the last few years I've been directing a Titanfall 2 inspired First Person Shooter with a lovely and talented team, and I thought I'd direct you all there! We're going to be coming out with more frequent updates soon, and we're about to release a Demo.

You can find it on steam : [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1994700/Mantra/]Mantra[/url] 
or on twitter : [url=https://twitter.com/rubysharkgames]twitter.com/rubysharkgames[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hey All!

Next update is live.

- Added scoring in, now upon winning or losing, you're presented with a scoreboard that says what you got up to for that round, and what your highest score is.

- Cleaned up user interface, text is crisper, and buttons are animated (Thank you Unity 2019 for the button prefabs making this easy.)

- Escape menu now showcases more than just audio settings, you can click through and review the game instructions mid-game.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Just wanted to post a quick update.
V1.1 is Live!

 - Blue triangles should no longer go through walls.

 - Blue enemies no longer teleport to location after 2nd pushback attack

 - Powerup text background now has a black outline, making it easier to read against the background.
